label: HDL and reverse cholesterol transport
reason: All members cover cholesterol/phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly/remodelling and LXR-driven efflux genes.

label: Nuclear-receptor control of hepatic lipid/glucose metabolism
reason: SREBP, PPARA, LXR and PGC-1alpha programmes regulating lipogenesis, triglycerides and gluconeogenesis form one nutrient-sensing theme.

label: IL-6 family gp130 JAK-STAT3 signalling
reason: IL-6, IL-11, LIF, CNTF and OSM signalling via gp130/STAT3 with ERK activation and auto/paracrine terms as minor additions.

label: Steroid hormone biosynthesis
reason: Adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis via CYP enzymes, their deficiency disorders and regulation of steroid output.

label: Insulin secretion and glucose homeostasis signalling
reason: Beta-cell insulin secretion (KATP, incretins, FFAR1), insulin receptor/GLUT4 signalling, glucagon and glycogen regulation share one glycaemic-control theme.

label: MET/ERBB/PTK6 RTK signalling and endocytic downregulation
reason: MET/HGF and ERBB2-PTK6 signalling linked to ubiquitin/ESCRT-mediated receptor internalisation and lysosomal downregulation of the same RTKs.

label: K+ channel control of membrane excitability
reason: TREK/TRESK/BK channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarisation, with sensory, hair-cell and bladder smooth muscle readouts.

label: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral type I IFN signalling
reason: RLR sensing, TRAF3/6-IRF activation, ISG15 and viral evasion of these pathways.

label: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling in cell motility
reason: Lamellipodia, filopodia, ruffles, Arp2/3 nucleation, Rho-PAK/ROCK and focal adhesion terms all concern actin-driven protrusion and migration.

label: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics
reason: SUMO conjugation machinery plus nuclear envelope breakdown/ESCRT-III resealing, linked by SUMO modification of NE/NPC and Ran pathway proteins in mitosis.

label: Cardiac conduction system electrophysiology
reason: SA/AV node, His-Purkinje, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling all govern cardiac impulse conduction.

label: Carbohydrate metabolism: glycogen, fructose, hexose transport
reason: Glycogen storage diseases, fructose/galactose handling, hexose transporters and glycolysis/gluconeogenesis; alanine terms a minor oddity.

label: Pyruvate, TCA cycle and CoA metabolism
reason: PDH, TCA intermediates, malate-aspartate shuttle, carboxylate transporters and CoA biosynthesis share central mitochondrial carbon metabolism.

label: Axon growth, guidance and regeneration
reason: Sema3A repulsion, axon sprouting, regeneration and growth inhibition all concern axon extension control.

label: Sperm function, fertilisation and germ cells
reason: Capacitation, acrosome reaction, zona binding, sperm motility and germ-cell development form one reproductive theme.

label: Early neural plate and axial patterning
reason: Neural plate regionalisation, neural crest/border specification, notochord, floor plate and hindbrain HOX patterning.

label: FGF receptor signalling
reason: All members are FGFR1-4 ligand binding, downstream FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades and oncogenic FGFR mutants.

label: Polymerase-mediated DNA synthesis in replication/repair
reason: Strand elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal, BER gap-filling, TLS and telomere C-strand synthesis share PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis.

label: RTK-RAS-MAPK/PI3K signalling
reason: FGFR, ERBB, MET, IGF1R signalling and RAS/RAF/MAPK pathway mutants all converge on canonical RTK-RAS-ERK/PI3K signalling.

label: Circadian clock and metabolic nuclear receptors
reason: BMAL1/CLOCK/CRY/PER clock plus PGC-1alpha, PPARA, gluconeogenesis, linked by REV-ERB/ROR clock-metabolism coupling; few odd members (N-terminal acetylation).

label: Bile acid homeostasis and intestinal sterol absorption
reason: Bile acid synthesis, transport, enterohepatic recycling, ABC transporter defects and intestinal cholesterol absorption.

label: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-12/23/17/10 axis
reason: Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal sensing linked specifically to IL-23/Th17 and IL-12/IL-10 cytokine production and signalling.

label: Protein quality control and misfolded protein clearance
reason: Ribosome quality control, N/C-degron pathways, ERAD, aggrephagy and stress granules all serve proteostasis.

label: NO-cGMP regulation of vascular tone
reason: eNOS activation/trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation controlling blood pressure.

label: Renin-angiotensin and renal blood pressure control
reason: Angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium/volume handling and vasoactive peptide catabolism regulate blood pressure.

label: Phosphate and vitamin D mineral homeostasis
reason: NaPi-II transporters, vitamin D activation/inactivation, PTH and FGF23-Klotho signalling regulating phosphate and bone mineralisation.

label: Axon guidance cue signalling
reason: L1, ephrin, netrin/DCC and Slit/Robo signalling in commissural guidance and fasciculation.

label: Angiogenesis and endothelial cell biology
reason: VEGF/VEGFR, Tie2, neuropilin, sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial differentiation; synoviocyte proliferation a lone oddity.

label: Grab-bag of unrelated processes
reason: Sample spans transcription, telomeres, immunity, RNA processing, apoptosis, sperm acrosome and metabolism with no common theme.

label: G2/M cell cycle transition and checkpoint
reason: Cyclin B/CDK1, PLK, MASTL, Chk1/2, DREAM/E2F targets and G2/M checkpoint modules.

label: Glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid membrane lipid metabolism
reason: Synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling of PC/PE/PS/PI/PG/CL plus sphingolipid/ceramide metabolism and lipid transfer.

label: Neddylation and cullin-RING ubiquitin-mediated degradation
reason: NEDD8/COP9 regulation of cullin ligases and CRL-mediated degradation of PD-L1, AURKA, NRF2, DVL and NOTCH4.

label: T cell tolerance and DC regulation of activation
reason: Costimulation, anergy, Treg differentiation and dendritic cell control of CD4/CD8 T cell activation.

label: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
reason: VSMC proliferation, migration, differentiation, apoptosis and dedifferentiation in vessel remodelling.

label: Bile acids and dietary lipid absorption/lipoprotein assembly
reason: Bile acid synthesis/transport linked via enterohepatic emulsification to intestinal lipid, vitamin E absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly.

label: Inflammasome, pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18
reason: NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2 inflammasomes, caspase-1 cytokine processing, pyroptosis and IL-18 signalling.

label: TLR/LPS sensing and inflammasome-driven inflammation
reason: TLR2/4/5-MyD88/IRAK4 signalling and NLRP inflammasomes, linked by the priming-activation model of inflammatory cytokine production.

label: Leukotriene and lipoxin eicosanoid metabolism
reason: 5-lipoxygenase products: leukotriene/lipoxin synthesis, transport, omega-oxidation and catabolism.

label: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and migration
reason: RPTP signalling, Rho/Rac inhibition, focal adhesion disassembly and reduced lamellipodia/adhesion.

label: Gonadotropin control of gonadal development
reason: FSH/LH secretion, follicle development, ovulation, luteinisation, Sertoli/Leydig cell development.
